name: Hesperian-Spire
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by dust seas stretching to the horizon near the terminator.
The air carries cold salt and iodine, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Established during the last boom, the quarantine zone was never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Business at the outpost is steady and deniable. Newcomers are welcome, watched, and priced accordingly.
